scope: Current generic catalog attribute coverage, evaluated against primary school lists and manufacturer specifications; not exhaustive commercial product or stock coverage.

findings.current_coverage: Format, sheets and ruling exist, but no margin definition or binding exists.
findings.proposal: Add optional con_margen and explicit margin-required variants or custom requirements.
findings.caveat: Missing does not mean false; do not mark all existing notebooks as having margins.

findings.current_coverage: No binding/spiral attribute exists; current college/university names leave it unspecified.
findings.proposal: Add an optional spiral boolean; require a separate text detail only if simple/double/side placement is needed.
findings.caveat: A college format alone does not prove that binding is stitched or spiral-free. Preserve special classroom instructions.

findings.current_coverage: 31 notebook items cover 40/60/80/100 sheets; none has 150. The field and binding already exist.
findings.proposal: Add a researched 150-sheet, 7 mm notebook option with explicit binding only when required.
findings.caveat: 150 sheets are not 150 pages. Do not turn manufacturer title Liso into blank ruling or infer a subject count from Triple.

findings.current_coverage: Only the 4B item has a typed hardness; a generic pencil and jumbo pencil remain unspecified.
findings.proposal: Add ordinary HB and 2B generic variants using the existing hardness attribute.
findings.caveat: Do not backfill HB onto the existing unrestricted Lápiz grafito requirement.

findings.current_coverage: Lápiz grafito jumbo triangular already says triangular in its name, but only tamano=Jumbo is structured.
findings.proposal: Add body shape independently from size; review an explicit triangular backfill for that named item and future variants.
findings.caveat: Jumbo, triangular and graphite hardness are separate properties; one must not imply the others.

findings.current_coverage: The global tipo_punta definition exists but Escritura does not bind it. Markers currently encode usage and color only.
findings.proposal: Reuse tipo_punta for marker shape only, with round/chisel variants where explicitly supported. Pair it with an independent thickness-class field when both are specified.
findings.caveat: Round/chisel shape does not determine whether the tip is fine or broad. No millimeter width is inferred from shape.

findings.current_coverage: Corrector has only its type; presentacion already exists globally but is not bound in Escritura.
findings.proposal: Reuse presentacion for an explicit liquid corrector variant and leave the generic item unrestricted.
findings.caveat: Tape correction is a plausible further format but is not evidenced by the sources attached to this finding.

findings.current_coverage: Color is available to Bicolor, Bolígrafo and Marcador, but not Destacador; the only highlighter item has no color.
findings.proposal: Extend conditional color applicability to Destacador and add green/yellow choices.
findings.caveat: The school allows green OR yellow: use one alternative requirement with a shared quantity, not two mandatory rows.

findings.current_coverage: No grammage field exists. peso_g is grams of product and must not be reused.
findings.proposal: Introduce paper grammage with an explicit g/m² unit; expose it only for paper types with evidenced variants.
findings.caveat: The manufacturer supports the grammage endpoints; do not fabricate every intermediate value or parse ambiguous bare grams as grammage. Local availability is not established.

findings.current_coverage: The sheet-count definition exists but Papeles has no binding or counted pack variants.
findings.proposal: Bind sheet count to these paper types and create clearly named pack/ream requirements, e.g. one 500-sheet carta ream.
findings.caveat: List quantity counts requested packs; the attribute counts sheets inside each pack. Do not turn unrestricted paper into a 500-sheet requirement.

findings.current_coverage: Both dimensional definitions exist, but in Papeles they currently apply only to Papel lustre.
findings.proposal: Extend both dimensions to Cartulina and use the explicit 26.5 × 37.5 cm sheet variant.
findings.caveat: Use physical sheet dimensions from the product contents, not shipping/package dimensions or assumed universal pliego dimensions.

findings.current_coverage: Acabado is bound only to Cartón, Goma EVA and Papel autoadhesivo; only unrestricted colored cardstock exists.
findings.proposal: Extend acabado to Cartulina with explicit metallic and fluorescent variants.
findings.caveat: A finish is not a color or a brand; avoid replacing ordinary cardstock with a special-finish requirement.

findings.current_coverage: Organización color applies only to Separador. Folders/covers cannot express the subject-color requirements through attributes.
findings.proposal: Extend color applicability to Carpeta and Forro, then curate source-backed choices alongside existing format and closure.
findings.caveat: The cover color belongs to the cover requirement; do not silently equate it to notebook-paper color or force every notebook to have a cover.

findings.current_coverage: Folders have format and closure fields but no sleeve count or presentation-folder variant.
findings.proposal: Add optional sleeve count and a clearly named oficio folder with 20 sleeves.
findings.caveat: 20 sleeves are not 20 folders, 20 loose sheets or a guaranteed number of display pages. Keep material and cover hardness optional unless specified.

findings.current_coverage: numero_colores exists only as an Arte binding; paper/EVA sets can currently say Surtido but cannot specify a count.
findings.proposal: Reuse the color-count definition for explicitly counted paper/EVA packs.
findings.caveat: The Torre example has 18 sheets but 14 colors. Do not derive colors from sheets, pieces, or package quantity.

findings.current_coverage: The eraser boolean is defined and bound to Grafito, but no current catalog item has a value.
findings.proposal: Add explicit with-eraser and without-eraser options where requested; both boolean states should be filterable.
findings.caveat: An absent value remains unspecified, not false; do not infer presence from the graphite grade.

findings.current_coverage: No marker thickness-class definition exists. A single tip-shape field cannot express fine and round simultaneously.
findings.proposal: Add a separate optional textual tip-thickness class, allowing combinations such as redonda plus fina without overwriting tip shape.
findings.caveat: School sources name fine/broad tips rather than exact line widths. Do not manufacture millimeter values or treat this label as a measured stroke width.

findings.current_coverage: Sacapuntas doble con depósito stores tamano=Doble and con_deposito=true. The shared size key mixes hole count with graphite size Jumbo.
findings.proposal: Add a numeric sharpener hole-count field; review replacing the named double sharpener’s Doble size classification with two holes while preserving identities and existing list snapshots.
findings.caveat: Hole count does not imply container presence or physical dimensions. Do not infer single-hole count for unspecified sharpeners or modify already curated values blindly.

findings.current_coverage: Presentation and color count exist, but volumen_ml is not bound to this category.
findings.proposal: Bind volume to Témperas and add explicitly sourced single-bottle requirements, beginning with 250 ml.
findings.caveat: For sets, per-pot volume and total set volume differ; do not place a per-pot amount in a field labeled total content. Only 250 ml has current school-list demand here.

findings.current_coverage: color exists globally but has no Arte y dibujo binding; current paint items only describe assorted sets.
findings.proposal: Allow individual paint colors as optional filters and requirements; retain assorted sets.
findings.caveat: The school calls these suggested alternatives. Do not turn its suggested palette into six mandatory separate purchases.

findings.current_coverage: Sketchbook sheet count and dimensions exist, but no grammage definition exists.
findings.proposal: Create an optional paper grammage field and bind it to sketchbooks/drawing blocks, shared with paper categories.
findings.caveat: Proarte explicitly verifies 70 g/m². The school uses the shorthand 80 gr; preserve that wording for review until its exact g/m² meaning is corroborated, rather than treating it as total paper weight.

findings.current_coverage: Dimension fields are bound to Croquera/Lienzo but not Block; blocks only have generic type/number/fraction, with no populated sheet counts.
findings.proposal: Extend both existing dimension fields to Block; add the evidenced pair 26.5×37.2 cm as an explicit variant.
findings.caveat: Do not assume every manufacturer uses identical dimensions for a named block fraction.

findings.current_coverage: Existing number/shape fields have flat 4/6/14 and round 2/4/6 only.
findings.proposal: Add sourced brush requirements for sizes 8 and 10; flat size 10 is explicitly requested.
findings.caveat: Brush number is a manufacturer size designation, not millimeters. A source giving number without shape must remain unspecified on shape.

findings.current_coverage: Both entries are generic; peso_g exists globally but has no Arte y dibujo binding.
findings.proposal: Bind net content by mass to modeling materials; keep clay, air-dry paste and cold porcelain distinct when adding exact variants.
findings.caveat: FILA directly verifies 250/500/1000 g for air-drying modeling clay. The additional Artel material-specific mappings are indexed: paste 500 g, clay 1000 g, cold porcelain 250/500 g. Do not treat air-dry paste, traditional firing clay and cold porcelain as equivalent or generate unsupported cross-combinations.

value_evidence.material_family: Pasta/arcilla de modelado que seca al aire
Pasta de modelado que seca al aire

findings.current_coverage: peso_g already applies to glue, but only glue-stick 21/40 g are populated. White glue has unspecified and 250 ml variants.
findings.proposal: Add glue-stick 20 g and white-glue 225 g/250 g requirements with exact mass units.
findings.caveat: 250 ml is separately supported by Santo Domingo and is not an error. Never convert glue grams to milliliters without product density;20 g is not 21 g. Torre directly confirms 225 g; STAEDTLER independently confirms 20 g in official indexed product text, although its direct page was rate-limited.

findings.current_coverage: Tip shape and left-handedness exist; largo_cm exists globally but is not bound to scissors.
findings.proposal: Bind length to scissors and permit an explicit 13 cm variant when requested.
findings.caveat: Preserve generic left-handed requirements without forcing 13 cm; this is manufacturer product evidence, not a universal school specification.

findings.current_coverage: Existing tape fields cover material/color/presentation; width is not defined.
findings.proposal: Create tape width in millimeters;12 mm masking tape has direct school-list demand.
findings.caveat: 18 mm applies to the crystalline tape evidence;36 mm to masking. Width must not be confused with roll diameter or package dimensions.

findings.current_coverage: No length-in-meters field exists; craft category currently has only type.
findings.proposal: Create length in meters for tape rolls and yarn; use 30 m crystalline tape,40 m masking tape and 50 m yarn as sourced examples.
findings.caveat: These are lengths per roll/ball, not list quantities or lengths of an entire wholesale pack.

findings.current_coverage: Only generic Palitos de helado exists, with no craft attribute bindings beyond type. numero_piezas exists globally.
findings.proposal: Reuse the same proposed package-content field as hygiene consumables for a clearly named 50-stick bag. Preserve loose-stick requirements.
findings.caveat: Keep loose-stick requirements possible. One requirement quantity 50 means 50 bags if the selected item itself is a 50-piece bag; UI must distinguish pack content from requested units.
findings.design_review: Reserve numero_piezas for constituent parts of functional sets such as Tangram; use unidades_por_envase for consumer-pack contents. This is a deliberate refinement of the initial binding-only suggestion.

findings.current_coverage: Only generic Pompones de colores exists; acabado is defined globally but is unbound to Manualidades.
findings.proposal: Reuse the existing finish attribute for glitter/shiny pompoms, with consistent Spanish value and search aliases for glitter.
findings.caveat: Do not infer individual diameter from a supplier package dimension; assorted colors and sizes can remain unspecified.

findings.current_coverage: No lavable definition exists. Generic glue names cannot distinguish explicitly washable requirements.
findings.proposal: Support an optional washable requirement for glue when an authoritative source explicitly requests it.
findings.caveat: Do not set false on existing unspecified items; washability conditions vary by substrate and no generic safety/non-toxic claim follows from this flag. Torre directly confirms washable 225 g school glue; the school evidence for requiring washability is indexed.

findings.current_coverage: Glue-stick, cold glue and silicone share the same type; presentation Bar/Liquid does not uniquely distinguish adhesive families.
findings.proposal: Add optional adhesive-family values Cola fría and Silicona alongside presentation. Resolve other family labels before offering them as mutually exclusive choices.
findings.caveat: This is a navigation/model recommendation supported by distinct school requirements. It must not alter existing item identity or reinterpret unspecified generic glue.
findings.design_review: Pegamento escolar overlaps Cola fría and is not a disjoint family value. An unspecified adhesive or glue-stick requirement must not be recategorized by assumption.

findings.current_coverage: One unspecified Transportador item; only the type is saved. No angular-range definition or binding exists.
findings.proposal: Add an optional angular-range attribute and a 180-degree variant. Keep the unspecified protractor selectable.
findings.caveat: Do not infer 360-degree support or diameter from the generic item. Range is not the angle of a set square.

findings.current_coverage: One unspecified Escuadra item; no angle definition or binding.
findings.proposal: Add an optional set-square angle and a 45-degree variant; bind existing largo_cm when a declared commercial length is known.
findings.caveat: A right-angle set square has several angles: this field must mean its distinguishing acute angle. Do not infer which side the source means by 15 cm.

findings.current_coverage: Global material definition exists, but Geometría does not bind it; both existing items are unspecified.
findings.proposal: Bind material conditionally to Escuadra and Transportador and use it only on explicitly material-specific variants.
findings.caveat: This source does not establish that every school wants plastic or that every current generic item is plastic.

findings.current_coverage: Aseo has only the type binding. volumen_ml exists globally but neither Aseo binding nor content values exist.
findings.proposal: Bind volumen_ml to Jabón and Alcohol gel. Current 2026 evidence supports liquid-soap refill 1000 ml; historical 2025 evidence supports soap 500 ml and gel 250 ml.
findings.caveat: Preserve bottle/package quantity separately. The 2025 source must remain labeled historical; do not infer concentration or efficacy. Soap presentation/refill/dispenser are separate optional properties.

findings.current_coverage: Only generic tissue and wet-wipe items exist; no per-package content-count attribute is defined.
findings.proposal: Represent wet-wipe pack 80 and tissue box 90 as per-package contents. Add presentation separately if helpful.
findings.caveat: Five packs of 80 is not 80 list items; six boxes of 90 is not 90 boxes. Do not reuse numero_hojas (paper sheets) or numero_piezas without a documented common pack-content meaning.

findings.current_coverage: Only Toalla de mano exists with type. Shared dimension_menor_cm/dimension_mayor_cm exist but have no Aseo binding.
findings.proposal: Bind both shared dimensional attributes to Toalla and add an explicit 30 × 40 cm option.
findings.caveat: A paired dimension is required to express this source; 30 alone is incomplete. Generic hand-towel remains valid when dimensions are not specified.

findings.current_coverage: Flauta dulce soprano stores only tipo_musica; fingering is neither a definition nor a value.
findings.proposal: Add a conditional fingering attribute. German-fingering school variant has direct 2026 evidence; Baroque is a manufacturer-verified alternative only.
findings.caveat: Do not silently assign German fingering to the generic soprano flute. Fingering is not tuning or pitch; labels such as afinación alemana in some lists should normalize carefully.

findings.current_coverage: numero_notas exists but is bound only to Metalófono. The Melódica item has only type.
findings.proposal: Extend numero_notas to Melódica and add the school-evidenced 32-note option. If a separate key count is needed later, document the semantics instead of silently treating every instrument equally.
findings.caveat: Exact 32-note evidence is in La Salle; Pumahue requests at least 32 keys. Preserve minimum wording rather than reducing a flexible requirement to exact 32.

findings.current_coverage: The sole typed option is cromático 25 notas; numero_notas and its binding already work.
findings.proposal: Add 22-note catalog coverage and make chromatic vs other scale properties explicit when curated.
findings.caveat: CPV also requests uncolored bars: count alone does not completely represent that particular school requirement. Do not infer the bar colors of generic or 25-note items.

findings.current_coverage: capacidad_gb exists and is bound correctly; current catalog only includes 8 GB.
findings.proposal: Add 16 GB coverage and support writing a minimum-capacity requirement without adding irrelevant brand/speed restrictions.
findings.caveat: The source says minimum 16 GB; 32 GB and larger may satisfy it. Existing exact-value facets do not express this acceptance rule. Capacity here is storage capacity, not free space.

findings.current_coverage: Existing dictionaries distinguish Español and Inglés-español through idioma, but no content/scope attribute exists; no synonyms-and-antonyms item exists.
findings.proposal: Add optional dictionary-content scope and a Spanish synonyms-and-antonyms option; preserve the existing language field.
findings.caveat: Language alone cannot distinguish two Spanish dictionaries. Named suggested publishers are not generic attributes, and specific editions belong in notes when required.

findings.current_coverage: The 20 × 30 cm white-board dimensions exist. Global tipo_pauta is text but currently labeled Pauta musical and bound only to Cuadernos/Música, with one Media pauta value.
findings.proposal: Reuse tipo_pauta for the optional board ruling after deliberately generalizing its display name from Pauta musical to Tipo de pauta. Bind it to Pizarra with Cuadriculada; preserve the existing music binding and values.
findings.caveat: Reuse requires the label review: the current Pauta musical label is inappropriate for boards. The source gives no grid spacing, so do not invent cuadricula_mm or classify the existing generic board as blank. Keep category-specific choice sets.

category_research.notes: Rulers of 15, 20 and 30 cm and the 100 cm tape are already typed. An unspecified compass is valid.

category_research.notes: All eight generic items are valid; none currently offers specific characteristics.

category_research.notes: Tangram with seven pieces and white board 20 × 30 cm are already typed. No blanket piece counts are inferred for base-ten blocks or body sets.

category_research.name: Otros
category_research.notes: An empty category is not evidence of missing attributes; do not create unrelated types just to fill it.

deferred.reason: Carpeta, Grafito, Corrector and Destacador remain useful unrestricted requirements. Blank details are not data-integrity errors.
Triple is used commercially and in school lists, but subject/separator count should not be inferred without explicit product data. Sheet-count 150 is separately supported.

deferred.topic: Notebook covers, compulsory school colors, assignment names
deferred.reason: Classroom-specific conventions must remain optional list choices. Some schools explicitly discourage plastic covers; there is no universal default.

Current Escritura types lack these families. Official school lists indicate they merit a later family expansion; diameter/line-width definitions need separate scope from pencil-body size. No unsupported 0.5/0.7 values added to this dataset.

deferred.topic: Paper dimensions and finish beyond selected types
deferred.reason: Kraft, crepé, volantín and Spanish cardstock need product-specific measurements, not a single assumed pliego size. No cartesian expansion is justified.

deferred.topic: Health, safety, ecology and washable claims
deferred.reason: Do not invent non-toxic, certified, recyclable or washable attributes from generic names. Such claims need product-level evidence and are not defaults for school requirements.

deferred.topic: Folder material, cover hardness, compartments, binder spine width
deferred.reason: Useful future optional dimensions; present source examples alone do not justify mass backfilling old general folders or inventing every combination.

deferred: Keep ordinary/Jumbo colored pencils and all6/12/24 color-count changes from007; no reason to replace the existing numeric color engine.

Brush material (camel hair/synthetic), paint gel presentation, acrylic paint as a separate type, washable markers, and solid-vs-oil pastel are useful secondary candidates, but need dedicated source mapping before populating.

Existing canvas30×40 is already typed; school20×20 can be an additive dimensional variant. Existing croquera format/sheets/dimensions support21×32/80 and22×32/100; adding those is a data-coverage task, separate from introducing grammage.
Punzón support dimensions20×25cm and long-sleeve art-smock construction are explicit in Santo Domingo, but lower-priority than core browse filters and should not become defaults.

Craft needles, elastic thread, yarn, sequins, glitter, sticks, pompoms, supports, stickers and modeling tools lack most detail bindings. Add fields only where a teacher meaningfully chooses them; avoid merchandising dimensions, packaging weight, brands and wholesale counts.
No inferred toxicity/allergy/age-safety certification should be introduced as a boolean based only on a generic item name or a retailer claim.

False and unspecified must remain distinct for any new boolean. Names, attributes and snapshots of existing user lists should remain preserved; corrections need explicit evidence and additive migration design.

The20g glue-stick manufacturer page remains rate-limited, though official indexed specifications corroborate the school list. No verified Chilean requirement for USB connector/speed or calculator programmability was found in this bounded review. Do not invent mandatory features from brand models.

design_rules: Keep generic unspecified attributes absent, never false or guessed.
Do not generate a Cartesian product of evidenced values or transfer one source product specification to a generic family.
Reuse existing definitions and preserve category-specific applicability.
Separate list quantity from per-package contents, color count from sheet count, mass from volume, and grammage from mass.
Do not tighten any-of or minimum requirements into multiple mandatory or exact-only requirements.
Current lists, published snapshots, identities, and progress must remain unchanged by future catalog curation.

local_findings.proposal: Canonicalize future catalog values after reviewing equivalent spellings, preserve names/identities and existing list snapshots.

local_findings.proposal: Retain minimum wording in name/note now; future structured requirements need explicit comparison semantics, separate from discovery filters.

local_findings.verified_behavior: src/catalog.rs validate_attribute(number) accepts positive finite numbers up to 1000000; it has no per-definition integer/count rule. This is a code inspection, not a live write test.
local_findings.proposal: Add per-definition numeric constraints when introducing count fields, preserving fractional dimensions and valid legacy values.

value_mapping_policy: Explicit value_evidence and paired_values override summary arrays. Summary arrays never authorize Cartesian products. Where mapping or material/type assignment remains ambiguous, a future seed requires row-level review.
